title: Release of @velexis/ota-sdk 1.0.0
caption: README §9, ota/sdk/release/CHANGES.md. Today (2026-11-20) the package is prepared (version 1.0.0, CHANGELOG "1.0.0 (unreleased)") but private: true and licence UNLICENSED, and the publish workflow is a draft that never runs. Target: tag and publish by about 18 December 2026, 31 December at the latest.

states.label: 0.x in the workspace only
states.detail: `workspace:*` in the storefront and the OTA admin.

states.label: 1.0.0 prepared, private (now)
states.detail: SDK-015: `package.json` and `src/version.js` say 1.0.0; `"private": true` makes npm refuse a publish; `ota/sdk/release/sdk-publish.draft.yml` waits for the owner's line-by-line approval (by SHA-256 in CHANGES.md).

states.label: licence chosen, draft approved, npm org ready
states.detail: The draft moves to `.github/workflows/sdk-publish.yml` deleting only its two DRAFT header lines (lead decision 33c).

states.label: release commit on main
states.detail: Removes `private`, sets `license` and the `repository` field, dates the CHANGELOG section.

states.label: dry run of SDK publish
states.detail: `dry_run` (default true): tests, build, pack, `npm publish --dry-run`, no release.

states.label: published with provenance + GitHub release
states.detail: 1.0.0 only with `credential: npm-token` (environment `npm`'s `NPM_TOKEN`); the release names the tarball integrity and the IIFE's SRI hash.

states.label: trusted publishing only
states.detail: Owner adds the trusted publisher on npmjs.com; later versions use `credential: trusted-publishing`; the token is revoked.

states.label: workflow refuses
states.detail: Not a tag of main, wrong version, still private or UNLICENSED, repository mismatch, undated CHANGELOG, or `npm-token` for a version other than 1.0.0.
